files.title: In the news: one pin per article
files.legend_text: Each pin is one news article (19 Oct - 19 Nov 2026) whose headline names a Cape Town suburb, placed at that suburb's OSM point and spread 80-150 m so pins do not stack. Colour = topic from a headline keyword rule.
files.notes: summary is 1-2 sentences written from the headline only (summary_basis='headline') or headline plus the outlet's RSS description ('headline+snippet'); it adds nothing beyond those. url is the publisher URL where we had one (outlet RSS or GDELT); url_is_google_redirect=true marks Google News links, which open the article in a browser via Google's redirect. An article naming two suburbs has two pins.
files.source: GDELT DOC 2.0 API, Google News RSS search, outlet RSS feeds; places from OpenStreetMap place=suburb/neighbourhood/etc. within the City of Cape Town (ODbL).
files.licence: Headlines are quoted as titles with links only; place points (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.
files.vintage: News 19 Oct - 19 Nov 2026, collected 19 Nov 2026; OSM extract at collection time.
files.caveats: Headline-only matching; news over-represents crime, the CBD and the Atlantic seaboard; Google News search coverage thins for older dates.

files.title: In the news: places named in headlines
files.legend_text: Number of unique news headlines (19 Oct - 19 Nov 2026) that name the suburb. Generic 'Cape Town' mentions are not counted.
